dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit sharp, dark perimeters with lighter, lower-contrast interior centers. The most prominent structures show a distinct gradient transition from a well-defined dark boundary to a high-intensity internal core, primarily located along the mid-dorsal flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of asymmetrical, solid dark pixel clusters lacking internal gradients. These are concentrated between the macro-annuli, with a secondary cluster of smaller, high-intensity light-colored spots located near the ventral-lateral transition.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the upper right quadrant form an obtuse scalene triangle. These structures are linked by a series of smaller high-intensity blobs that follow a linear path toward the posterior flipper.
